title: Lecture 1 | Modern Physics: Classical Mechanics (Stanford)
summary: The first lecture of Leonard Susskind's Stanford Continuing Studies course on modern physics, beginning with classical mechanics. It is the start of a six-quarter sequence on the theoretical foundations of physics.
why: HN recommends Susskind as a very good explainer who uses real math at an accessible level, and links this lecture series for self-learners.

quote.text: He is a very good explainer.
